ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

fields.topology_type: Single PCD (master, field-generator) + 1..N PICCs (slaves, field-powered) sharing a single 13.56 MHz inductively-coupled RF channel. PICCs are anti-collision-resolved by UID (Type A) or PUPI (Type B). After Layer 3 SELECT, exactly one PICC is in ACTIVE state; remaining PICCs can be HALTed and later re-engaged via WUPA / WUPB.

supported_topologies.name: Single PCD + single PICC
supported_topologies.description: Most common case — door access, ticket validator, payment terminal.

supported_topologies.name: Single PCD + multiple PICCs
supported_topologies.description: Anti-collision enumerates all PICCs in field; PCD HALTs each in turn to discover the next.

supported_topologies.name: Single PCD + Type A + Type B mix
supported_topologies.description: PCD must alternate REQA and REQB polls; both types coexist in the same 13.56 MHz field.

supported_topologies.name: Co-located PCDs
supported_topologies.description: Only one PCD's field is active at a time within the operating volume; coordination is host-level (out of ISO 14443 scope).

supported_topologies.name: NFC peer-to-peer (NFCIP-1)
supported_topologies.description: Strictly out of ISO 14443 scope; uses NFC-DEP / Type F per ECMA-340 / ISO 18092.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates 13.56 MHz field; transmits all commands; controls bit rate + modulation + Cascade Level + bit-frame split.
Field-powered; replies only when polled or selected; load-modulates the 847.5 kHz subcarrier.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The 13.56 MHz field is the flat 1-PCD : N-PICC channel; Layer 3 addresses by UID (Type A) or PUPI (Type B); Layer 4 addresses by CID (1..14 simultaneous T=CL sessions are theoretically possible but rarely used in practice).

ordering_guarantees.within_a_block: Bits LSB-first per byte on the wire; receiver reassembles in same order.
ordering_guarantees.across_blocks: Strictly sequential per direction at Layer 4; alternating block number detects lost block; no out-of-order delivery.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: There is no shared memory region on the air interface. PICC memory (Classic sectors / Ultralight pages / DESFire files / NTAG NDEF area) is layered above Layer 3/4 and addressed via family-specific command sets (READ / WRITE / ReadData / WriteData / AUTH).

device_classification.pcd_reader_chip: NXP CLRC663 / PN5180 / PN512 / MFRC522 / TRF7970A / ST CR95HF — connects via SPI/I2C/UART to host MCU.
device_classification.picc_chip_classic: MIFARE Classic 1K / 4K — Crypto1 stream cipher above Layer 3; no T=CL.
device_classification.picc_chip_plus: MIFARE Plus 2K / 4K — supports SL1 (Classic-compat), SL2 (AES sector auth), SL3 (full AES + T=CL).
device_classification.picc_chip_desfire: MIFARE DESFire EV1/EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light — AES / 3K-3DES file system above T=CL.
device_classification.picc_chip_ultralight: MIFARE Ultralight / Ultralight C (3DES) / Ultralight EV1 (password + GetVersion) — no T=CL.
device_classification.picc_chip_ntag: NTAG21x / NTAG I2C — NFC Forum Type 2 tag; URI/SMS encoded in NDEF; password (NTAG21x) and I2C bridge (NTAG I2C).
device_classification.picc_chip_jcop: JCOP smartcard — Java Card OS + ISO 7816-4 APDU above T=CL.
